cards.text: After His talk with Nicodemus, Jesus heads out into the Judean countryside with His disciples. He spends some time with them there. And He baptizes.
Meanwhile John, the one who was baptizing people before Jesus came on the scene, is baptizing at Aenon near Salim. And people KEEP coming.

cards.question: Why is John baptizing at Aenon near Salim?

answers.text: It is close to the temple
It is far from the crowds

cards.question: The writer slips in a side note here. At this point, John has already been thrown into prison.

cards.text: Then an argument breaks out between John's disciples and a certain Jew.

cards.question: What's the argument between John's disciples and this man about?

cards.text: So John's disciples go to him and call him Rabbi. They bring up the One who was with John beyond the Jordan, the One John testified about.

cards.question: John's disciples have news about that One, Jesus. What do they tell John?

answers.text: He is baptizing and everyone is going to Him
He has left Judea and gone back to Galilee
He wants John to come and baptize with Him

cards.text: Everybody going to the new guy? Friend, when that shiny new stamper landed on my counter, I had THREE speeches ready. John doesn't give a speech. He gives one calm sentence.

cards.question: John answers that a man can receive only what is given him from ___.
John reminds his disciples of something they heard him say themselves. What was it?

answers.text: I am not the Christ but am sent ahead of Him
I am the Christ but must wait for my time
I am sent to baptize until He is ready

cards.text: Then John paints a wedding picture, and now he's speaking MY language. The bride belongs to the bridegroom, and the friend of the bridegroom stands and listens for him.

cards.question: In John's wedding picture, how does the friend of the bridegroom feel when he hears the bridegroom's voice?
John says that joy of the bridegroom's friend is his own joy, and it is now complete.
So John sums up where he stands next to Jesus: He must ___; I must ___.

cards.text: "He must increase; I must decrease." Everyone's heading to Jesus, and John is GLAD about it. Me? I got slid to the back of a junk drawer and didn't crack a single joke for YEARS.
John keeps going. He talks about two kinds of speakers: the One who comes from above, and the one who is from the earth.

cards.question: John says the one from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks like it. What does he say about the One who comes from heaven?

cards.text: The One from heaven testifies to what He has seen and heard. That's not something He picked up secondhand in a group chat. That's an EYEWITNESS.

cards.question: John says everyone accepts the testimony of the One from heaven.
John adds a line about whoever does accept His testimony. What has that person certified?

answers.text: That he has kept the law

cards.text: Why do His words carry so much weight? Because the One whom God has sent speaks the words of God.

cards.question: John says God gives the Spirit without ___.
John says the Father loves the Son but has placed only some things in His hands.

cards.text: Then John lands the whole thing with two roads: believe in the Son, or reject Him. No third lane, friend. Not even a shoulder to pull over on.

cards.question: What does whoever believes in the Son have?
John says whoever rejects the Son will not see life, and the wrath of God remains on him.

findings.problem: "After His talk with Nicodemus" is a fact from outside the passage (John 3:1-21). The card cites only John 3:22 and gives no reference for it. The verse itself says only "After this."

rule.text: Facts from outside the passage are fine when they help, like who a new person is or who wrote a letter, with their reference.

findings.problem: John is introduced as "the one who was baptizing people before Jesus came on the scene." That fact comes from outside the passage (John 1) and has no reference. The card cites only John 3:23.

rule.text: Facts from outside the passage are fine when they help, like who a new person is or who wrote a letter, with their reference.

findings.problem: Card 2 says "people KEEP coming" to Aenon. That setup rules out the wrong answer "It is far from the crowds."

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

findings.problem: "John doesn't give a speech. He gives one calm sentence." The text shows John giving a long answer, from 3:27 through 3:36. Stop 2 card 1 even says "John keeps going." "Calm" is also stated as fact, not marked as Papa Dorin's guess.

rule.text: Papa Dorin can retell in his own words and fill in what the text clearly implies. Scene-setting details are fine. He never says anything the text shows is wrong.

findings.problem: "When that shiny new stamper landed on my counter, I had THREE speeches ready" adds a new detail to his backstory. In the backstory he is simply picked up and slid into the drawer. The made-up moment is set in the Millers' kitchen, not around his bakery.

rule.text: His backstory, family, bakery and mission are the Dorinverse story in this file. He can talk about them freely, but never adds anything new to them. His jokes can make up small moments and habits around his bakery.

findings.problem: The card repeats "He must increase; I must decrease," which the baker just answered on card 15. It moves the passage no further, so it is a recap card. ("John is GLAD about it" restates 3:29, already covered on cards 13 and 14.)
"Didn't crack a single joke for YEARS" stretches his backstory. The backstory says he stopped joking "for a while," until the can opener arrived.

rule.text: His backstory, family, bakery and mission are the Dorinverse story in this file. He can talk about them freely, but never adds anything new to them.

findings.problem: The wrong answer "That John was right" can be argued as right. John testified about this One (3:26, 3:28), so accepting His testimony arguably confirms John.

rule.text: No near-matches. A wrong answer never means the same as the right answer, or close to it. If a baker could argue it's right, replace it.
